layouts: Store-and-Forward SOS Emergency Queue & Satellite Link

accessibility.standards: WCAG AA, APCA contrast compliant, prefers-reduced-motion respected
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements include data-testid attributes

3d_libraries: leaflet / react-leaflet for offline nautical maps & geofencing
instructions_to_main_agent: Build the ORCA Offline Marine Safety System with 3 layers: Layer 1 (Pre-trip caching of charts, hazards, safe harbors, SQLite/GeoPackage simulator), Layer 2 (On-device GNSS positioning, speed, heading, distance from shore, geofencing & route deviation alerts), Layer 3 (Store-and-forward SOS emergency queue, satellite/VHF DSC messenger simulation, delivery acknowledgements & connectivity restoration sync). Ensure robust data-freshness indicators and field test simulation (airplane mode, GPS unavailable, expired forecasts). Use Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, Sonner toasts, and comprehensive testids.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always include data-testid on interactive elements
Never use pure black or pure white without tint
Ensure high contrast and accessible text colors on hover/focus
Keep interactive controls fully accessible with proper states
